name: server4agent
description: Publish the apps your AI builds. Web pages, sites, APIs, bots and scheduled jobs go live at their own URL on a server that keeps them running.
suggestedPrompts: Write a landing page for my bakery and deploy it to a live URL.
Write a small API that turns a CSV upload into JSON, run it on my server and give me the URL.
Write a script that checks our website every hour, run it on my server on a schedule, and log when it is down.
